name: claude-cache-tools
description: Tools for managing Claude Code's prompt cache and TTL

plugins.name: cache-keepalive
plugins.description: Keep Claude Code's prompt cache warm across idle pauses. A Stop hook stamps activity and a background Monitor pings the session only after it has been idle long enough (default 50 min) to threaten the TTL, refreshing the cache with one cheap read. Built for a 1h TTL; disable on request-quota subscriptions.
